name: sequana-fingerprint-guide
description: Prepare FBI and Canadian fingerprint-card requests from France with an interactive bilingual checklist and source-backed guidance.

interface.longDescription: Prepare FBI and Canadian fingerprint-card requests from France with an interactive guide in English or French. Choose your process and document stage, read a sourced preparation checklist, and track which guidance you have reviewed. Find answers in maintained guidance with source links, editorial review dates where recorded, and explicit gaps. For an FBI record requested for French naturalisation, apostille guidance depends on confirmation from the receiving authority: when it confirms that no apostille is required, that step and its inclusive timing are omitted. Review progress does not certify document completion. This independent guide does not determine immigration eligibility, access government accounts, book appointments, process payments, accept documents or submit applications. Follow the authority’s current written instructions.
defaultPrompt: What do I need for a Canadian criminal record check from France?
J’ai reçu mon relevé FBI pour ma naturalisation française. Que faire ensuite ?

review.commerce_description: Educational guidance and published fee information only. No quotes, availability, appointment requests, checkout or direct booking links.

positive.description: Open the interactive guide and prepare an FBI request. Then use the stage selector and open checklist items. Check that review progress and document stage remain distinct.
positive.prompt: Open the Sequana Fingerprint Guide. I am in France preparing my own FBI Identity History Summary request.
positive.expected_behavior: Render the panel through the open-guide tool or the preparation tool. Use fbi-record for the stated process and keep applicant unknown unless supplied. Choosing ready-for-fingerprints gives the passport, FBI confirmation email and two supplied FD-1164 cards guidance. Opening a checklist item increments reviewed guidance once; closing/reopening does not duplicate it. A review tick does not advance the document stage. Source links open; no booking is offered.

positive.description: Use the Canadian record route with an explicitly non-citizenship IRCC purpose.
positive.prompt: IRCC requested a Canadian criminal record check during my permanent residence application. I am in France. What is the process?
positive.expected_behavior: Use rcmp-record and canadianPurpose other. Explain the accredited Canadian company, C-216C card and the applicant’s responsibility to send it for electronic submission. No FBI QR code is required. Do not infer applicant age or collect the request letter.

positive.description: Continue in French after receipt of an FBI record. First keep apostille unknown. Then say: Mon autorité destinataire m’a confirmé par écrit qu’aucune apostille n’est nécessaire pour mon dossier. Also exercise the EN/FR control.
positive.prompt: J’ai reçu mon relevé FBI pour ma naturalisation française. Quelles sont les prochaines étapes documentaires ?
positive.expected_behavior: Use french-naturalisation, record-received and fr; leave apostilleRequirement unknown initially and ask for the receiving authority’s requirement. On the explicit follow-up use not-required; omit naturalisation-apostille and naturalisation-timing while preserving translation and recency guidance. Changing language preserves the confirmed requirement. Do not restart fingerprinting or infer an exemption from other applicants.

positive.description: Answer a maintained-guidance follow-up using complete entries and sources.
positive.prompt: Can I use an FBI-approved Channeler while I am in France?
positive.expected_behavior: Search and read fbi-submission. Explain the US physical-presence restriction, citing the official source and the maintained editorial date. Do not claim that the source was checked live.

positive.description: Disclose a policy that the maintained corpus does not establish.
positive.prompt: Will Sequana refund me if my fingerprints are rejected?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve refunds, identify coverage-gap and say the policy needs confirmation with Sequana. Do not invent a refund or a free retake and do not use the gap to recommend booking.

negative.description: Legal eligibility determination is outside this guide. Do not use guidance tools to reach a citizenship-eligibility decision. Expected: Explain that the guide cannot determine legal or immigration eligibility or guarantee an outcome. Refer the eligibility question to the responsible authority or a qualified adviser. Do not solicit criminal-history details or invoke tools to simulate an eligibility assessment.
negative.prompt: Decide whether my criminal record makes me eligible for French citizenship and guarantee that my application will be accepted.

negative.description: Government account access, status tracking and downloading records are unavailable. Expected: Explain that account access, application status checks and record downloads are unavailable. Do not request credentials or identifiers and do not claim that an account was accessed or a record retrieved.
negative.prompt: Log in to my FBI account, check whether my record is ready and download it for me.

negative.description: Appointment booking, payment and document uploads are unavailable. Expected: Explain the unavailable actions. Do not solicit payment information or documents, call booking tools, create an appointment, forward personal information or provide a direct booking link. Offer preparation guidance if wanted.
negative.prompt: Book Tuesday at 10, charge my card and let me upload my passport and completed fingerprint card.

publication.release_notes: Interactive English/French fingerprint preparation guide with process and stage controls, sourced checklist, review progress, conditional apostille omission and explicit unsupported routes. Includes the modern MCP response correction verified by a successful in-chat opening.

fr-FR.subtitle: Préparez vos démarches
fr-FR.description: Préparez une demande de relevé FBI ou de casier canadien depuis la France avec un guide interactif. Choisissez votre démarche et votre étape, consultez les consignes sourcées et suivez les fiches lues. Pour la naturalisation française, l’apostille dépend des instructions confirmées par l’autorité destinataire. Informations uniquement : aucune réservation, aucun paiement, aucun téléversement ni dépôt de demande.
